snippet.title: Gameplay 1ST TEASER TRAILER || The Game Has Strated || Visual novel
snippet.description:
Summer. You and your classmates go on a special vacation to the “Bolashaq” camp. Suddenly you all wake up in a strange place, that is copy of your school! There is some “Trickster” that welcomes you to the Game, where in order to get out and survive you need to earn certain points. Most points are given from an unsolved murder, which brings up a classic Mafia game to the table! Investigate murders, face the trials and executions from the Houses, to discover the mystery behind this Game and open gates to the EXIT.

“The Game Has Started” is a horror indie murder mystery visual novel game. Investigate the murders, prepare for trials and build up different relationships with characters! Game perfectly matches the aesthetics of old-retro visual novels. Face the trials, as they remember who you truly are.

Fan of Danganronpa, Doki Doki literature club, FNAF, Зайчик, or a just a fellow gamer? Then you totally need to get a look on The Game Has Started! Soon, we will upload our Steam Page and Trailer, so be ready to WISHLIST us! Next announcement are going to be revealed in short time.

The Game Has Started takes place in Kazakhstan, Astana. Game’s story and art is quiet really inspired by Kazakh culture, mythology, and places! So, it is also possible that you will see some familiar shots inside!

Cast of characters:
Aydin, Yara, Emir, Bay, Sara, Mari, Moldir, Amir (YOU), Igor, Ali, Skar, Lekha, Danya, Diar, Kai, Alina, Nova and Vona, Shurik, Timoha / Timka, Jester, Baryska, Arlan, Tulpar, Sunkar and others…
